_comment: Task descriptor list. Each task = one minimal action compared clone-vs-real-Word. The runner derives file paths by convention: probe=parity/probes/<id>-pilot-probe.js, com=parity/ground-truth/realword_<id>.ps1, fixtures=parity/fixtures/{wc,rw}-<id>.docx. realword_method: 'com' (scriptable, COM==ribbon) or 'vsto' (gallery/style action where COM != ribbon -> needs real UI capture). Run a tier batch with: python parity/engines/run.py --tier T0 --capture (Word closed).

tasks.note: WARNING (COM != ribbon): numbering.xml IS now diffed, and the large numbering.xml delta is a COM-method ARTIFACT — COM ListFormat.ApplyBulletDefault() writes a singleLevel abstractNum while the ribbon Bullets button (and the clone) write a multilevel one, so the clone's extra levels read as 'extra' even though the clone is MORE ribbon-faithful than this COM ground truth. A TRUE numbering.xml comparison needs a vsto/UIA ribbon capture. The document.xml ground truth (numPr + pStyle ListParagraph) IS faithful — and the document.xml gap (missing pStyle ListParagraph + numPr child order) is now FIXED by feature 023, so the BODY is at parity; the remaining diff is PURELY the numbering.xml COM-artifact.

_dialog_identified_gaps.detail: Word Font.DoubleStrikeThrough -> w:dstrike. The clone has NO checkbox AND no textStyle attr; the w:dstrike translator round-trips on import only. Cannot author via dialog or bridge.
Word Font.Hidden -> w:vanish. No clone checkbox and no WC.PM verb; vanish round-trips on import only.
Word Font.Kerning -> w:kern (min-size threshold, half-points). No clone control and no textStyle.kern attr.

The underline-color EFFECT is faithful (fd-underline-color = 0/0 via the bridge), but Word's Font dialog has an Underline-color dropdown the clone's dialog omits (dialogs.js Underline row sets style only). Dialog-completeness gap.

The ligatures EFFECT is faithful (fd-ligatures = 0/0), but Word's Advanced tab has an OpenType Ligatures dropdown the clone's Advanced tab (Scale/Spacing/Position only) omits. Dialog-completeness gap.

All 4 pagination EFFECTS are faithful (fd-pag-widow/keepnext/keeplines/pagebreak = 0/0 via the bridge), but the clone's Paragraph dialog has NO Line-and-Page-Breaks tab — Word does. Dialog-completeness gap (016 scoped to add it).
Word writes abstractNum/lvl/rPr/rFonts; the clone has NO font picker AND applyListDefinition.js:77-78 STRIPS rFonts -> clone never emits a bullet font. numbering.xml-only.

NARROWED by review: the clone DOES emit w:lvlJc=left (Word's default; bullets.json shows it as an 'extra' only because the COM singleLevel ground truth omits it). The real gap is only the missing Centered/Right alignment FIELD (applyListDefinition writes numFmt/lvlText but no non-default lvlJc; defineNewBulletDialog has no align control).

_dialog_identified_gaps.field: Find / Match case / Whole word / Wildcards / Format
_dialog_identified_gaps.detail: Find + all search modifiers produce ZERO document delta (decorations/navigation only) -> flow-verifier axis, not OOXML. Wildcard grammar + whole-word definition differ COM-vs-clone (count, not identity).

_dialog_identified_gaps.field: Special codes in the REPLACE box (^p/^t/^l)
_dialog_identified_gaps.detail: Word translates ^p/^t/^l in the replacement (new w:p / w:tab / w:br); the clone passes replInput.value LITERALLY (search.ts) so it inserts the literal text '^p' instead of a paragraph break. Real clone gap on the replace path.

COM Tables.Add auto-creates an AutoFit-to-window TableGrid (+tblLook/default borders); the clone builds equal-width gridCols. Row/col COUNTS match; gridCol widths/tblW/borders diverge. (Covered by the existing 'table' pilot.)

_dialog_identified_gaps.field: Independent T/B/L/R margins via the dialog
_dialog_identified_gaps.detail: The clone's Custom Margins dialog exposes ONE uniform 'Margin (inches)' input applied to all four sides; Word's Page Setup sets top/bottom/left/right independently. (The bridge dePageMargins verb + presets do support distinct sides — measured via fd-margin-top/left — but the DIALOG cannot.)
